governing_acts: Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code
Country of Origin Food Labelling Information Standard 2016

requirements.title: Average Quantity System (AQS)
requirements.target_rule: National Measurement Act 1960 Part V & NTMR Part 4 adopt the international Average Quantity System (AQS). A pack may not have a shortfall exceeding tolerable negative error (TNE) and batch average must equal or exceed marked weight.
requirements.indian_rule: Under Indian LMPC 2011, Maximum Permissible Error (MPE) applies with specific percentage/gram tolerances.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Verify production packaging line is calibrated and audited to meet Australian AQS sampling thresholds.

requirements.title: Country of Origin Kangaroo & Bar Chart Standard
requirements.target_rule: Under the Country of Origin Food Labelling Information Standard 2016, imported foods must display a clear text statement in a defined box (e.g., 'Grown in India' or 'Made in India from Indian ingredients'). Australian-made goods require the kangaroo triangular logo and percentage bar chart.
requirements.indian_rule: Indian LMPC Rule 6(1)(a) requires statement of 'Country of Origin' for imported goods.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Place a bordered Country of Origin declaration statement on the package: 'Product of India' or 'Made in India'.

requirements.title: Price Marking & Prohibition of Government MRP
requirements.target_rule: Competition and Consumer Act 2010 (Australian Consumer Law) prohibits mandatory maximum resale price fixing. Retailers independently determine retail pricing and unit pricing.
requirements.indian_rule: Mandatory Maximum Retail Price (MRP) declaration under Rule 6(1)(e).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Remove Indian MRP text. Selling price is applied by Australian retail POS/shelf tagging.

requirements.title: Principal Display Panel Measurement Height
requirements.target_rule: NTMR Schedule 4 sets mandatory minimum letter height for net measurement based on package dimension: packages up to 120mm require minimum 2.0mm character height; 120-230mm require 2.5mm; 230-360mm require 3.3mm; over 360mm require 4.8mm.
requirements.indian_rule: LMPC Rule 7 Table I defines numeral heights based on net quantity volume/weight brackets (e.g., 200g-1kg requires 4.0mm height).
requirements.action_required_for_export: Audit front panel dimensions and adjust net weight font size to meet NTMR Schedule 4 minimums.

requirements.title: FSANZ Plain English Allergen Labelling (PEAL)
requirements.target_rule: FSANZ Standard 1.2.3 requires mandatory declaration of allergens (crustacea, egg, fish, milk, peanut, sesame, soybean, tree nuts, wheat, gluten, lupin, sulfites >10mg/kg) using specific required terminology in bold within the ingredients list AND in a separate 'Contains' summary statement.
requirements.indian_rule: FSSAI requires allergen listing, but the strict two-location Plain English Allergen Labelling (PEAL) format is unique to Australia.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Add both bold highlighted terms in the ingredient list AND a dedicated bold 'Contains: [Allergens]' summary statement immediately below the ingredients.

requirements.title: Australian or New Zealand Business Address
requirements.target_rule: Standard 1.2.2 requires the name and business street address (not PO Box alone) of the Australian or New Zealand importer, manufacturer, or vendor.
requirements.indian_rule: Rule 6(1)(a) requires the complete manufacturing address in India.
requirements.action_required_for_export: Print the Australian importer's registered business street address on the label.
